engine_counters.scope: cumulative window counters at driver install (after initial draw) and final observation; not per-frame metrics; counters are never reset and extra timing is not enabled; unavailable backend or missing final window is null

errors: successful-new-frame timestamps are diagnostic only; complete start/end intervals and per-frame scroll-position association remain unverified; aggregate counts cannot prove rendered traversal

gpu.source: Metal command-buffer GPUStartTime/GPUEndTime via the vendored Apple renderer
gpu.definition: sum of GPUEndTime-GPUStartTime over command buffers committed during a frame's submission; overlap is not removed; never part of the CPU budget

cpu.statistics_definition: nearest-rank quantiles; median is p50 (lower middle for even sample counts)
cpu.budget_comparison: every complete CPU scope must be at or below budget; known over-budget work fails even when acceptance is incomplete
eligibility_reasons: initial window drawing and first submission span separate CPU scopes; startup work is diagnostic, not a complete first-frame measurement
cpu.scope: whole synchronous CPU frame scopes plus exact draw/present associations
cpu.cpu_work_definition: Complete event end-start includes callbacks, draw, synchronous drawable acquisition, submission and cleanup without subtracting API-call elapsed time; split initial draw and submission remain separately measured, idle gaps are not CPU work
cpu.presentation_wait_definition: Legacy presentation_wait fields report elapsed wall time of the whole nextDrawable API call, including any internal CPU work, scheduling and waiting; they do not measure pure blocking or GPU time. This time remains included in all 2 ms acceptance judgements. Fields named diagnostic_*_excluding_drawable_call are descriptive differences only, never acceptance metrics.

metadata.renderer: concrete renderer not exposed by FrameTimingCollector
metadata.scenario_coverage: full top-bottom-top main-content traversal, repeated until the bound
metadata.workload: 8px scroll inputs from a timer independent of frame callbacks (MATERIAL_SCROLL_INPUT_HZ, default 1000), all startup/turn observations retained, FPS overlay enabled

gpu_measurement.source: Metal command-buffer GPUStartTime/GPUEndTime via the vendored Apple renderer
gpu_measurement.scope: per-frame sum of command buffers committed inside that frame's submission; separate from and never part of the CPU budget

metadata.ring_overflow_policy: full batch is incomplete, even if no loss can be proven
metadata.display_refresh_note: reported display cadence, separate from successful newly drawn frame submission FPS

sampled_state_limit: thermal_state and window_active are read during each observation; they do not prove state remained unchanged between observations; thermal getter calls the platform and its cost is included in driver work
timing_domains: CPU collector includes synchronous InitialDraw before open returns; FPS observations start when driver installs after open, not at CPU startup

coverage.visited_sections_reason: section identity is not exposed to the driver; row coverage is recorded instead
coverage.definition: logical offset lap reaches the reported bottom and returns to top; input observations do not prove every row was painted and successfully submitted, including rows below the deepest top row

input_driver.source: foreground timer, independent of frame callbacks
input_driver.pacing_limit: foreground work can delay timers; overdue deadlines are caught up with immediate ticks, so requested cadence is not measured constant input frequency

refresh_comparison_limit: rate comparison is diagnostic correlation, not proof of compositor pacing or an excuse to ignore measured FPS failure

successful_submission_diagnostic.scope: all captured target-window Present markers, including negative offsets before driver installation; Some(true) comes from backend success and new-draw identity, not Draw/Present pairing; false includes failed attempts or already-counted scenes
successful_submission_diagnostic.limit: diagnostic only; start/end interval coverage and association with changed scroll content remain unverified; timestamps are CPU submission completion, not GPU completion

submission_attempt_diagnostic.definition: attempt-only interior gaps; excludes start-to-first and last-to-end intervals; not a complete-run minimum or successful-frame rate; a failed first attempt and successful retry cannot be distinguished by aggregate counts

counter_limit: the full-window counter also includes FPS overlay and animation frames; input timing does not prove each counted frame carries changed scroll content
scope: attempted logical top-bottom-top main-content traversal; programmatic mode refreshes on offset change, wheel mode dispatches through platform input without explicit refresh; startup and turns retained; GPU time is in cpu.gpu

foreground_journal.scope: existing foreground journal collected after driver installation; only target-window platform signals and published skips plus stream-wide discontinuities; skip reasons are not exhaustive; coalesced request sources are not wake counts; no new hot-path instrumentation
foreground_journal.time_basis: signed nanoseconds relative to driver started, same origin as raw observations; negative offsets preserve signals requested before installation; null signal_at means unavailable
foreground_journal.loss_scope: lost aggregates batch lost values once; discontinuity markers describe the same loss, not additional loss; shared foreground stream loss cannot be assigned to a window
